title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em bauru. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios     Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:      Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior fpga developer em sumaré. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.    Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.    Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.    Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Our Compliance team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to manage conduct risk.    We’re looking for a Regulatory Compliance Manager to keep our consumer protection practice in compliance. You‘ll advise on crypto compliance requirements and related controls.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente. Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais. Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.    Qualificações Ensino médio completo Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento. Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial. Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!      Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.      Oferecemos Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível. Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.    VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?    Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.      Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)    Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract    Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)    Reports To: CRO / Founder    Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)      We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.    Key Responsibilities:   1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office). 2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese. 3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure). 4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.  Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.  What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

Empresa está contratando Business development & marketing em guarapuava. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About i QIYI    i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.      Role purpose    Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.      Key responsibilities   1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.    Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Immigration paralegal (immigration court / removal defense)
description:
Empresa está contratando Immigration paralegal (immigration court / removal defense) em diadema. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?      If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.      About Bueno Law      Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.      We specialize in:     Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration.    We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.      What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)     Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.    What We’re Looking For      Hard Skills     Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).    Soft Skills     Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.    Preferred Qualifications     3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.    What We Offer     Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead. Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed. Tasks are formally assigned with defined scope and timelines. Deliverables must meet a professional standard and align with the task categories above. Four weeks annual leave, sick leave + 9 days of public holidays. These can be used for your local public holidays if you wish Competitive salary in USD.     Things You Should Know About SOMO We are a Paid Media Performance agency. title: Direct response video editor for 8-figure dtc brand
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct response video editor for 8-figure dtc brand em guaíba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)     $1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses      We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1 M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.      Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, You Tube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.      What You'll Actually Do      High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.      Master Direct Response Mechanics:   Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches) Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, You Tube Shorts) A/B test visual approaches based on performance data    Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Da Vinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.      Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.      AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.      Top Fits Will Have: Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement) 2+ years editing for DTC/e Commerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal) Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners) Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or Da Vinci Resolve + After Effects Deep understanding of Meta/You Tube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)    Bonus Points: Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes) Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4 D) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools Portuguese + English fluency    Non-Negotiables: Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions) Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment Obsessive attention to detail Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback      Why Top Editors Choose Us:      Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.      Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.      See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).     ️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.      Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.      High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.      Application Process:      Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked    Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.      Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.      Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.      Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.      Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

description:

Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote      About the job:    We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.      You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with marketing activities for our agency and our clients. You will be responsible for helping prepare and launch ads, writing and editing ad copy using tools like Chat GPT and Grammarly, creating Canva designs, editing short videos in Cap Cut, scheduling posts, preparing reports, crafting personalized outreach messages, downloading and cleaning databases, checking campaign details before launch, and more. This is a full-time role Mon-Fri for 40 hours per week with occasional overtime. Work time from 9:30am – 6.00pm New York Time (with a 30-minute break). Diferenciais Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo. Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal. Protagonismo e senso de dono. Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos. Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe. Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade. Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset). Deve ser uma pessoa que compreenda profundamente a realidade das concessionárias e consiga transformar desafios operacionais e comerciais em oportunidades de aprendizagem, contribuindo para o crescimento das equipes, a excelência operacional e os resultados da rede de pós-vendas.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.    We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:      Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em araucária. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?      Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você . Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.      Seja diferente, seja independente

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. title: Supervisor assistencial
description:
Empresa está contratando Supervisor assistencial em londrina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.    Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo.É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.    Aqui na Oncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.      O que você irá fazer:      Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações    geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade, mantendo o sigilo sobre assuntos relacionados às    atividades da Oncoclínicas;    Conhecer, aplicar, promover e sugerir normas e condutas voltadas para saúde, segurança no trabalho e preservação ambiental, contribuindo para a eliminação de situações que possam representar riscos de acidentes no trabalho e degradação do meio ambiente;    Realizar ações para retenção de clientes através do monitoramento contínuo dos procedimentos,    intervenções, exames, dentre outras ações que se façam necessárias à conclusão do diagnóstico,    zelando pela otimização dos processos internos, bem como pelo acompanhamento e retorno    personalizado ao paciente;    Executar o plano de cuidados individualizado estabelecido aos pacientes em assistência de    enfermagem, conforme orientação estabelecida;    Responder pela equipe multidisciplinar e monitoramento das atividades dos setores de psicologia, nutrição, estomatologia, assistência social dentro da unidade;    Solicitar internação dos pacientes em hospitais de referência;    Monitorar taxa de internação e óbito para analises de indicadores assistenciais;    Realizar escala de plantão médico;    Planejar e agendar os procedimentos relacionados aos transplantes de medula óssea, conforme    protocolo interno, no intuito de conferir agilidade e eficácia ao processo em questão;    Prestar esclarecimento ao cliente, pessoalmente, via telefone e/ou por e-mail, visando a segurança e a satisfação do paciente durante o tratamento;    Monitorar exames de RNI dos pacientes que usam anticoagulante oral. Evoluir resultado em planilha própria e registrar a evolução nos respectivos prontuários a fim de contribuir com os procedimentos de ajuste de medicação;    Cadastrar e enviar material para testes genéticos dos pacientes oncológicos;    Participar da implementação e manutenção do processo de qualidade referentes à área de da equipe multidisciplinar, zelando pela realização dos procedimentos estabelecidos;    Triar e acolher os pacientes Oncológicos de primeira vez, analisando a necessidade de    encaminhamento e orientando em relação aos procedimentos que serão realizados;    Garantir o cumprimento legal da profissão, acompanhar registros junto aos órgãos competentes,    manter a equipe identificada em auditorias;      O que você precisa ter:   Superior Completo em Enfermagem, Nutrição ou Psicologia com registro ativo no respectivo órgão; Especialização em Oncologia; Experiência na função e área; Vivência em gestão de pessoas; Pacote Office.    Local : Pro Onco em Londrina    Horário: segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 18h.      O que oferecemos:    Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas    CLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;    Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.    É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.    Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO.    Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.    E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.    No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.      Venha construir com a gente!    E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer

title: Strategy & operations manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Strategy & operations manager em agudos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.    About the role    At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.    We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.    Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.    What you’ll be doing Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth Leading and executing core infrastructure projects Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms  What you'll need At least a 2:1 degree from a top university 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones To enjoy working with data Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact An interest in the financial industry  Nice to have Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R  Compensation range Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly* Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience    Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.    We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.    By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.      Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.       Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!       Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:      O Grupo Capital:      Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.      Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.      Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.       Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.      Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:      A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.      Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.      Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.      Responsabilidades:     Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.     Pré-requisitos:     Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.    Diferencial:     Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.    Você terá:     Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.    Modo de contratação:     Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital    Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!
