About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Segment manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Segment manager em piracicaba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Position Details    Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager    Department: Sales — Latin America    Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM    Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region    Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory      Role Objective    Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.      Primary Responsibilities    Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.  Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.  Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.  Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.  CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.    Qualifications & Experience    What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.  Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).  What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.    About Quectel    Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.    Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.    Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.      Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em caraguatatuba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.      Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.      Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.      Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Licensing operations, & financial resolution specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Licensing operations, & financial resolution specialist em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)    Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)    Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week      About Us    Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.    Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.    Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.      Role Purpose    This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.      Required Skills & Experience Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Net Suite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders Strong written communication skills and attention to detail Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support  Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements  Billing & Invoice Support Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests  Data Quality & Master Data Management Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, Net Suite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections  Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs  Reporting Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team) Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting  Service Expectations Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
description:
Nova oportunidade para Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno em campo bom. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Payfy  A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.    Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.     Sobre a vaga:  Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim.    Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim.      É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim.      O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero.      Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA.    Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca.      O que você vai fazer:    Calendário e planejamento   Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar  Produção visual   Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai  Vídeo   Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário  Publicação e acompanhamento   Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca)    O que a gente espera de você:    Requisitos   Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar    O perfil que a gente procura   Visão macro de projetos Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo Organização e consistência Senso de dono    Diferenciais   Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Cap Cut Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo Conhecimento de boas práticas de You Tube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção) Repertório em finanças/B2 B    Como é trabalhar aqui:   Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca Espaço para crescer    Processo seletivo:   Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing    O que oferecemos   Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00 Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses) Day off de aniversário Wellhub + Conexa Saúde Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia    Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy    Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.      Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.    Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Remote privacy lawyer - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Remote privacy lawyer - brazil em marília. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
description:
Confira a vaga para Data specialist (with advanced english) em campo bom. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.          Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Professor de inglês

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!      Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.      Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.     *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*      O que oferecemos?     Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.    Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?      Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .      Necessário:     Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.    O diferencial?      Aqui você é mais que um professor.      Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.      Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.      Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.      Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.      Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!      O que eu faço?     Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as    Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.      QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?     Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.      Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em passo fundo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
description:
Empresa está contratando Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno em fazenda rio grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Payfy  A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.    Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.     Sobre a vaga:  Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim.    Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim.      É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim.      O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero.      Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA.    Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca.      O que você vai fazer:    Calendário e planejamento   Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar  Produção visual   Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai  Vídeo   Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário  Publicação e acompanhamento   Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca)    O que a gente espera de você:    Requisitos   Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar    O perfil que a gente procura   Visão macro de projetos Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo Organização e consistência Senso de dono    Diferenciais   Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Cap Cut Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo Conhecimento de boas práticas de You Tube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção) Repertório em finanças/B2 B    Como é trabalhar aqui:   Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca Espaço para crescer    Processo seletivo:   Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing    O que oferecemos   Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00 Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses) Day off de aniversário Wellhub + Conexa Saúde Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia    Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy    Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.      Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.    Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:    Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.       Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!       Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:      O Grupo Capital:      Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.      Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.      Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.       Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.      Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:      A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.      Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.      Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.      Responsabilidades:     Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas; Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço; Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente; Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas; Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos; Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.     Pré-requisitos:     Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre; Proatividade orientada a resultados; Interesse em receber e dar feedback; Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia; Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos; Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.    Diferencial:     Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.    Você terá:     Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos; Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual; Programa de partnership estruturado; Treinamentos exclusivos; Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada; Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras; Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados; Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica; Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital; Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador; Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.    Modo de contratação:     Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital    Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

A vida fica melhor com sorvete    Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada. Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo. Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução. Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro. Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos. Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente. Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais. Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.    Qualificações Ensino médio completo Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento. Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial. Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!      Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.    VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?    Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Segment manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Segment manager em mauá. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Position Details    Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager    Department: Sales — Latin America    Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM    Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region    Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory      Role Objective    Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.      Primary Responsibilities    Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.  Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.  Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.  Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.  CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.    Qualifications & Experience    What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.  Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).  What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.    About Quectel    Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.    Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.    Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.      Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.
